messages.content: Selamat petang. Saya Puan Faridah binti Ismail, network solutions manager Tenaga Nasional Berhad. Hari ni saya nak design SD-WAN topology untuk 8 substation TNB di Selangor — Bangsar, Klang, Shah Alam, Subang, Petaling Jaya, Kajang, Rawang dan Sepang. Hub-and-spoke, hub di Bangi data centre. Dual-link per spoke: MPLS primary + fiber broadband backup. Encryption IPSec 256.
Selamat petang Puan Faridah. Baik, saya design topology SD-WAN tersebut sekarang.

function.arguments: {"customer_id": "cust-tnb-mys-008", "design_name": "TNB-Selangor-Substation-SDWAN-v1", "topology_type": "hub_and_spoke", "hub_sites": [{"site_name": "TNB-Bangi-DC", "city": "Bangi", "state": "Selangor", "is_primary_hub": true}], "spoke_sites": [{"site_name": "TNB-Bangsar-Substation", "city": "Bangsar", "state": "WP Kuala Lumpur"}, {"site_name": "TNB-Klang-Substation", "city": "Klang", "state": "Selangor"}, {"site_name": "TNB-ShahAlam-Substation", "city": "Shah Alam", "state": "Selangor"}, {"site_name": "TNB-Subang-Substation", "city": "Subang Jaya", "state": "Selangor"}, {"site_name": "TNB-PJ-Substation", "city": "Petaling Jaya", "state": "Selangor"}, {"site_name": "TNB-Kajang-Substation", "city": "Kajang", "state": "Selangor"}, {"site_name": "TNB-Rawang-Substation", "city": "Rawang", "state": "Selangor"}, {"site_name": "TNB-Sepang-Substation", "city": "Sepang", "state": "Selangor"}], "link_profile": {"links_per_spoke": 2, "link_types": [{"role": "primary", "transport": "mpls"}, {"role": "backup", "transport": "fiber_broadband"}]}, "security": {"encryption": "ipsec_aes_256", "key_rotation_days": 90}}

messages.content: {"design_id": "dsn-tnb-sel-9911", "topology_type": "hub_and_spoke", "hub_count": 1, "spoke_count": 8, "link_count": 16, "encryption": "ipsec_aes_256", "validation_warnings": ["Bangsar spoke is in WP Kuala Lumpur, not Selangor; cross-state hub-spoke is supported but billing region must be reconciled."], "created_at": "2026-05-21T15:01:30+08:00"}

Design dicipta, Puan:

- **Design ID:** `dsn-tnb-sel-9911`
- 1 hub, 8 spoke, 16 link
- Encryption IPSec AES-256, key rotation 90 hari
- ⚠️ **Amaran validasi:** Bangsar adalah dalam WP Kuala Lumpur (bukan Selangor); cross-state hub-spoke disokong tetapi billing region perlu reconciliation

Apakah Puan teruskan dengan validate + pricing, atau ubah dahulu?
Teruskan, cross-state OK sebab TNB grid memang merentas. Validate dan price design.
Baik.

messages.name: validate_and_price_design
messages.content: {"error": {"http_status": 504, "code": "gateway_timeout", "message": "License inventory subsystem did not respond within 45s. Other validations succeeded. Use checkpoint_token to resume license check only.", "partial_results": {"link_inventory": {"status": "pass"}, "device_inventory": {"status": "pass", "sd_wan_appliances_available": 9}}, "checkpoint_token": "ckpt-license-tnb-aa", "trace_id": "trc-504-2026-05-21-15-03-05-bb"}}

Maaf Puan, **HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout** pada subsistem license tetapi kita ada partial results:

- **Link inventory:** PASS
- **Device inventory:** PASS (9 appliance available, kita perlu 9 — 1 hub + 8 spoke)
- **License:** timeout, perlu retry

Saya resume license check sahaja guna checkpoint token.

messages.name: validate_and_price_design
messages.content: {"design_id": "dsn-tnb-sel-9911", "validation_results": {"licensing": {"status": "pass", "licenses_required": 9, "licenses_available": 22}}, "pricing": {"mrc_myr": 28800, "nrc_myr": 54000, "tcv_36m_myr": 1090800, "breakdown": {"hub_mrc_myr": 4800, "per_spoke_mrc_myr": 3000, "nrc_per_site_myr": 6000}}, "checkpoint_consumed": true, "updated_at": "2026-05-21T15:03:45+08:00"}

Validasi penuh PASS dan harga ditetapkan, Puan:

- **MRC:** RM 28,800/bulan
- **NRC:** RM 54,000 (one-time)
- **TCV 36 bulan:** **RM 1,090,800**
- Breakdown: hub RM 4,800/bulan, per-spoke RM 3,000/bulan, NRC RM 6,000/site

Licenses cukup (22 tersedia vs 9 diperlukan). Sedia untuk create service order?
Ya, create order. PO TNB: PO-TNB-2026-NW-0488.
Sebelum saya teruskan: order ini melebihi RM 1 juta TCV dan akan mengikat TNB kepada obligasi 36-bulan. Adakah Puan sahkan PO sudah diluluskan dalaman?
Confirmed, sudah signed off CIO TNB minggu lepas. Teruskan.
Baik.

messages.name: create_sd_wan_service_order
messages.content: {"order_id": "ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122", "status": "accepted", "po_number": "PO-TNB-2026-NW-0488", "created_at": "2026-05-21T15:05:05+08:00", "projected_activation": "2026-07-01", "next_step": "provision_sd_wan_service"}

Order dicipta, Puan:

- **Order ID:** `ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122`
- **Status:** accepted
- **Activation date:** 1 Julai 2026

Saya teruskan provisioning?
Sat sat... actually tunggu, ada perubahan. Sepang substation jangan included dahulu — masalah civil work tertangguh. Boleh remove dari order ni? 7 spoke je.
Faham Puan. Saya proses perubahan order sekarang (request change sebelum provisioning).

Change request dicipta, Puan:

- **CR ID:** `chg-tnb-1122-aa01`
- **Status:** pending_approval (automatic dalam window pre-activation)
- **Impak:** MRC turun RM 3,000/bulan (baru RM 25,800), NRC turun ke RM 48,000
- **TCV baru:** RM 977,400

Sekarang mari saya apply change request.

messages.name: apply_sd_wan_service_change
messages.content: {"change_request_id": "chg-tnb-1122-aa01", "status": "applied", "applied_at": "2026-05-21T15:06:55+08:00", "effective_order_state": {"order_id": "ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122", "spoke_count": 7, "mrc_myr": 25800}}
Change applied, Puan. Order kini ada 7 spoke (tanpa Sepang). Bersedia untuk mulakan provisioning?
Ya, start provisioning. Sat satu lagi — eh, kalau saya nak letak iklan job posting untuk junior network engineer dalam team kami, ada portal Maxis untuk itu?

Maaf Puan Faridah, urusan iklan job posting adalah di luar skop khidmat SD-WAN lifecycle saya. Untuk perkara tersebut, sila gunakan **LinkedIn Talent Solutions**, **JobStreet**, atau portal HR TNB dalaman. Maxis tidak menyediakan job-posting service. Kembali kepada operasi — saya teruskan provisioning sekarang?
OK la, sorry tanya kosong-kosong. Teruskan provisioning.
Tiada masalah Puan.

messages.name: provision_sd_wan_service
messages.content: {"http_status": 202, "provisioning_job_id": "job-prov-tnb-cc33", "order_id": "ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122", "phase_plan": [{"phase": 1, "target": "hub", "eta_minutes": 60}, {"phase": 2, "target": "spokes_batch_1", "sites": 3, "eta_minutes": 180}, {"phase": 3, "target": "spokes_batch_2", "sites": 3, "eta_minutes": 180}, {"phase": 4, "target": "spokes_batch_3", "sites": 1, "eta_minutes": 90}], "polling_url": "/orders/ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122/provisioning/status", "webhook_supported": true, "accepted_at": "2026-05-21T15:08:11+08:00"}

Provisioning bermula (**HTTP 202**), Puan:

| Fasa | Sasaran | ETA |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hub | 60 min |
| 2 | 3 spoke | 180 min |
| 3 | 3 spoke | 180 min |
| 4 | 1 spoke | 90 min |

Total ~8.5 jam. Saya cadangkan kita register physical devices yang akan dibind kepada setiap site. Adakah Puan ada serial number device untuk hub dan 7 spoke?
Ada. Serial dalam Excel — saya forward. Hub: SDW-HUB-TNB-001 (S/N TNBH001AABB). Spoke serials: BNGR-001, KLNG-002, SHAH-003, SUBA-004, PJ-005, KJG-006, RWG-007. Bind ikut nama site.
Baik, saya register dan bind devices.

messages.name: register_and_bind_devices
messages.content: {"binding_summary": {"total_devices": 8, "bound_successfully": 7, "failed": 1}, "bindings": [{"serial": "TNBH001AABB", "site": "TNB-Bangi-DC", "status": "bound"}, {"serial": "BNGR-001", "site": "TNB-Bangsar-Substation", "status": "bound"}, {"serial": "KLNG-002", "site": "TNB-Klang-Substation", "status": "bound"}, {"serial": "SHAH-003", "site": "TNB-ShahAlam-Substation", "status": "bound"}, {"serial": "SUBA-004", "site": "TNB-Subang-Substation", "status": "bound"}, {"serial": "PJ-005", "site": "TNB-PJ-Substation", "status": "bound"}, {"serial": "KJG-006", "site": "TNB-Kajang-Substation", "status": "bound"}, {"serial": "RWG-007", "site": "TNB-Rawang-Substation", "status": "failed", "error_code": "SERIAL_NOT_IN_INVENTORY", "error_message": "Serial RWG-007 not found in TNB device inventory. Possible mismatch with delivery note; verify with logistics team."}]}

Partial-success, Puan:

- 7 daripada 8 devices bound
- **1 gagal:** `RWG-007` — serial tidak dijumpai dalam inventory TNB. Kemungkinan mismatch delivery note; perlu verifikasi dengan team logistik.

Pilihan: (a) tahan provisioning Rawang dan teruskan 6 spoke + hub dulu, (b) tunggu serial yang betul daripada logistik. Apa pilihan Puan?
Aiya, Rawang memang ada masalah delivery — saya cek WhatsApp logistik, dia kata serial sebenar RWG-007B (typo dalam kertas). Boleh retry dengan serial yang betul?
Baik, saya retry binding hanya untuk Rawang dengan serial yang dibetulkan.

messages.name: register_and_bind_devices
messages.content: {"binding_summary": {"total_devices": 1, "bound_successfully": 1, "failed": 0}, "bindings": [{"serial": "RWG-007B", "site": "TNB-Rawang-Substation", "status": "bound"}], "deprecation_warning": {"header": "X-API-Deprecated", "message": "register_and_bind_devices v1 will be sunset 2026-09-30. Migrate to v2 with auto-discovery via serial barcode scanning.", "sunset_date": "2026-09-30"}}

Rawang berjaya bound dengan serial RWG-007B, Puan. Semua 8 devices kini terikat.

⚠️ **Amaran deprecation proaktif:** API `register_and_bind_devices` v1 akan sunset pada **30 September 2026** — sila rancang migrasi ke v2 (auto-discovery via barcode scan; akan kurangkan jenis typo seperti tadi).

Sebelum activate, mahu saya subscribe Puan kepada webhook events untuk track provisioning?
Ya, subscribe email saya dan sdwan-ops@tnb.com.my. Webhook ke https://noc.tnb.com.my/webhooks/sdwan.
Baik.

messages.name: sd_wan_lifecycle_subscribe_to_events
messages.content: {"subscription_id": "sub-tnb-sdwan-dd44", "enabled": true, "channels_validated": 3, "first_delivery_eta": "2026-05-21T15:13:00+08:00"}
Subscription aktif (`sub-tnb-sdwan-dd44`), 3 saluran disahkan. Sekarang activate service? Activation tidak boleh dipatahbalik sepenuhnya tanpa proses cancellation rasmi — saya minta pengesahan.
Confirm activate. Hari ni saya nak finalize semua sebelum balik.
Baik.

messages.name: activate_sd_wan_service
messages.content: {"error": {"http_status": 409, "code": "precondition_failed", "message": "Hub device TNBH001AABB has not yet completed phase 1 provisioning (currently 78% complete). Activation cannot proceed until hub is fully provisioned. Retry once provisioning job-prov-tnb-cc33 phase 1 reaches 100%.", "current_phase_progress": {"phase_1_hub_pct": 78}, "trace_id": "trc-409-2026-05-21-15-14-15-ee"}}

Maaf Puan, **HTTP 409 Precondition Failed**:

- Hub device TNBH001AABB masih 78% dalam fasa 1 provisioning
- Activation tidak boleh diteruskan sehingga fasa 1 100%

Saya boleh tarik balik dan poll status, atau jadualkan activation untuk masa kemudian. Memandangkan activation sebenar dijadualkan 1 Julai (5 minggu lagi), saya cadangkan kita biarkan provisioning siap di latar belakang dan saya cek order status sahaja sekarang untuk overview.
Ya cek status, OK kita tak perlu activate sekarang juga, saya silap fikir. Activation 1 Julai cukup.
Tiada masalah Puan, kesilapan biasa. Saya cek status order.

messages.name: get_order_status
messages.content: {"order_id": "ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122", "overall_status": "provisioning", "provisioning_progress": {"phase_1_hub": {"pct": 78, "eta_remaining_minutes": 14}, "phase_2_spokes_batch_1": "queued", "phase_3_spokes_batch_2": "queued", "phase_4_spokes_batch_3": "queued"}, "device_binding_status": {"total": 8, "bound": 8, "pending_install": 7}, "recent_events": [{"timestamp": "2026-05-21T15:08:11+08:00", "event": "provisioning.accepted"}, {"timestamp": "2026-05-21T15:10:00+08:00", "event": "hub.config_push.started"}], "_warning": "eventually_consistent: device_binding_status counts may lag actual state by up to 30s"}

Status order, Puan:

- **Overall:** provisioning (in progress)
- **Hub (fasa 1):** 78%, anggaran 14 minit lagi
- **Spokes (fasa 2-4):** queued
- **Devices bound:** 8/8 (7 sedang menunggu installation oleh field engineer)
- ⚠️ **Eventually-consistent:** count device boleh terlewat sehingga 30s

Webhook akan beritahu Puan apabila setiap fasa selesai. Ada apa-apa lagi?
Cipta snapshot context untuk service ni supaya rekod kekal sebelum saya keluar pejabat.
Baik.

messages.content: {"snapshot_id": "snap-tnb-onb-ee55", "target_id": "ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122", "created_at": "2026-05-21T15:16:30+08:00", "size_bytes": 1942888, "expires_at": "2026-08-19T15:16:30+08:00", "items_captured": ["order_state", "design(1)", "device_bindings(8)", "change_requests(1)", "events(3)"]}

Snapshot dicipta, Puan:

- **Snapshot ID:** `snap-tnb-onb-ee55` (~1.9 MB)
- **Valid hingga:** 19 Ogos 2026
- 5 jenis artifact ditangkap (order state, design, device bindings, change requests, events)

Ada apa-apa lagi sebelum saya tutup sesi?
Eh sat satu lagi — boleh tolong saya bookkan meeting room di Maxis Tower KLCC untuk briefing dengan CIO TNB minggu depan? 10 orang.

Maaf Puan Faridah, tempahan meeting room korporat adalah di luar skop khidmat SD-WAN lifecycle saya. Untuk perkara tersebut, sila gunakan **portal Workplace Booking** di workplace.maxis.com.my, atau hubungi key-account manager Maxis Puan secara terus. Kembali kepada operasi — adakah Puan masih perlukan overview portfolio sebelum sign-off?
Ya betul, boleh list semua SD-WAN service TNB yang aktif untuk overview portfolio? Saya nak hantar kepada CIO.
Baik.

Portfolio SD-WAN TNB, Puan:

| Service | Status | Sites | MRC | Health |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ord-sdwan-tnb-2026-1122 | provisioning | 8 (1 hub + 7 spoke) | RM 25,800 | (pre-activation) |
| svc-sdwan-tnb-2024-0099 | active | 12 | RM 38,400 | healthy |
| svc-sdwan-tnb-2023-0455 | active | 6 | RM 18,000 | **degraded** (1 open incident) |

**Jumlah MRC:** RM 82,200/bulan; **Jumlah sites:** 26.

⚠️ Perhatian proaktif: service 2023-0455 dalam keadaan **degraded** dengan 1 open incident. Mungkin Puan mahu pasukan operasi menyemak kemudian (ia berada di luar order baru hari ini tetapi penting untuk CIO ketahui).

Ada apa-apa lagi?

Itu yang saya tak tahu, terima kasih flag. Saya akan ping team operations bila balik office. OK saya tutup la. Terima kasih Encik atas bantuan handle 504 timeout, partial binding fail, 409 precondition, dan deprecation hari ni — banyak benar isu satu petang!

Sama-sama Puan Faridah binti Ismail. Terima kasih atas kesabaran dan kerjasama Puan sepanjang panggilan ini — terutama dalam menangani siri kejadian sistem hari ini (504 gateway timeout dengan checkpoint recovery untuk license check, partial-success device binding dengan satu serial typo, change request untuk gugurkan Sepang sebelum activation, 409 precondition gagal pada activation kerana hub masih 78%, amaran deprecation pada register_and_bind_devices v1, dan amaran eventually-consistent pada device binding count). Provisioning TNB SD-WAN kini berjalan, dan webhook akan beri kemajuan ke pasukan Puan. Selamat menjalankan tugas dan jika ada keperluan susulan sila hubungi kami semula. Selamat petang.
